high_level_description: This image shows a group of seven individuals posing for a photo outdoors on a tiled patio area. The setting appears to be a warm, possibly desert-like environment, as indicated by the presence of palm trees in the background and the sandy-colored walls of the building behind them. The group consists of men dressed in a variety of traditional and modern outfits. Starting from the left, the first person is wearing a long blue robe with gold embroidery, paired with brown shoes. Next to him, the second individual is dressed in a gray robe with black pants and black shoes.
